purpose: WebSubInterface is a Slicer scripted module that connects 3D Slicer, as an "Image Display" client, to a FHIRcast/WebSub-style messaging hub. Browser worklists send it studies to open. It can also start a bundled local FastAPI hub as a subprocess and download browser clients (SPAs) from the author's GitHub release.
summary: The extension is MIT-licensed, has no obfuscation, and no reviewer-directed text. Pip installs are gated by a confirmation dialog. I found one likely load-breaking packaging defect: Lib/spa_download.py is imported at module load but is not in the CMake SCRIPTS list. Other concerns: the module imports aiohttp at load time, before any install prompt; the local hub binds 0.0.0.0 by default with mock auth and a known default JWT secret; the hub's PyJWT dependency is not in the install list; and downloaded SPA zips are unverified. The catalog entry uses scm_revision "main", which is allowed but moving. Review is partial: I did not read many hub and client files in full.
not_checked: <parameter name="">Did not read most of hub/Lib/routes/*, binary_publish.py, payload_store.py or client.py in full.
questions_for_author: <parameter name="">Is aiohttp available in Slicer's Python without a separate install? If not, how is the module expected to load before the user clicks Start?
